Reduce Deduction —

New total deduction
What happens on save:
• Loans — the reduced amount tops up future months that are below the chosen monthly repayment, and only adds a new month if they are all already full.
• Manager Notes — the reduced amount is logged in Deferred Deductions on the Loans page and taken in full next month.
